title: Bearer credential: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: Synthetic Bearer credential values built to the documented format appear in 3 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Bearer is a transport scheme, not a provider-specific credential format. Generic value masking is project policy.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (provider documentation); claim not itemised.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Detector coverage" (detector-coverage); not yet reviewed.
